items.q: What is Dan Olson's real subject after GameStop?
items.a: Not "little guy beat Wall Street" as the whole story. January 2021 is the **prologue**. The enduring phenomenon is a **post-squeeze cult** — meme-stock ape culture built on gambling addiction, soap-opera drama, and conspiracy lore.

items.q: Why can't Apes and outsiders agree on what "GameStop" means?
items.a: **Two realities**: Apes see a cosmic fight for generational wealth; outsiders see a struggling mall retailer that got a temporary lifeline. You're **not talking about the same thing**.

items.q: What does the SEC picture of the January peak look like?
items.a: Some **short covering** was in the mix, but **retail buyers overwhelmingly drove** the peak near **$500**. Melvin lost big (Citadel bailout); many bag holders were retail, not Citadel.

items.q: How did holders rewrite January after the music stopped?
items.a: They recast January as **"the sneeze"** and invented **MOASS** — the mother of all short squeezes — as the real event. Holders stuck near **$420** needed an even bigger squeeze to get whole.

items.q: When did naked-short and DRS lore explode?
items.a: Naked shorts, DRS/ComputerShare, DTCC, and Ken Griffin letters mattered little in January, then exploded **Feb–Mar** as explanations for **why it didn't keep squeezing**.

items.q: What makes Ape "due diligence" a cargo cult?
items.a: It's **research theater that never updates priors** — volume without falsifiability. Mods, shills, and paid opposition become permanent narrative furniture instead of testable claims.

items.q: How is ape culture worse than ordinary gambling?
items.a: It has gambling's **addictive highs + soap-opera energy**, but Apes convince each other blackjack has a secret **"hit 31, win the tray"** rule — **addiction mechanics without real odds** of winning.

items.q: What is the Keith Gill paradox in the documentary?
items.a: Roaring Kitty / DFV is mythologized as **prophet** while remaining **causally smaller than legend**. His silence gets read conspiratorially; Ryan Cohen tweets become Rorschach signals.

items.q: Was Robinhood's buy-button halt a targeted hit on Apes?
items.a: Dan's mundane read: **limited margin / collateral mechanics**, not a conspiracy masterstroke — though it still catalyzed a **persecution complex** that fueled the lore.
**Melvin closed in 2022**; **Citadel recruited from WSB**; Hudson Bay and others farmed **predictable dip-buying**. The retail-hero narrative coexists with hedge funds monetizing irrationality.
